item.title: Newton County Schools announces 2026 STAR Students
item.description: Newton County Schools has announced its 2026 STAR Students, highlighted by a tie for District STAR Student.

item.title: Catalyst Initiative at the Oxford College of Emory University hosting food distribution event on Saturday
item.description: The Catalyst Initiative at the Oxford College of Emory University is hosting a food distribution on Saturday, Feb. 28 from 10:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. at 2160 Church St. in Covington

item.title: Dr. Jasmine Clark in Covington on March 1 for Meet and Greet
item.description: East Metro for Social Justice is announcing a Meet & Greet with Dr. Jasmine Clark, candidate for Georgia’s 13th Congressional District, to be held on March 1 in Covington.

item.title: Covington woman sentenced to prison after stealing $4 million in gift cards from Home Depot
item.description: A Covington woman was sentenced to serve three years and one month in federal prison after she stole more than $4 million in gift cards from Home Depot.

item.title: One down, four to go: Zoey Jackson, Kandice Shepard lead Lady Rams to Sweet Sixteen
item.description: One down, four to go in the quest for ring No. 2. The Newton Lady Rams moved one step closer to a second consecutive state championship on Tuesday night, defeating the Norcross Lady Blue Devils 61-42 in the first round of the 6A state tournament.

item.title: Eastside overcomes the Demons, advances to Sweet Sixteen for first time since 2023
item.description: For the first time since 2023, the Eastside Eagles are Sweet Sixteen bound. On Wednesday the Eagles knocked off the visiting Warner Robins Demons in the first round of the 4A state playoffs in a 58-40 result. The win comes after two consecutive first-round exits, including a stunner against Union Grove in 2025.

item.title: Newton boys basketball falls to high-powered Peachtree Ridge team in opening round
item.description: Newton took its talents on the road for the first round of the Class AAAAAA playoffs, but the Peachtree Ridge Lions ended the Rams’ season with a 63-47 win. Wednesday’s game was a rematch of last year’s Sweet 16 game that saw Newton win 61-46. When it came time for this year’s Round of 32 battle, it proved to be the Lions’ day. A game-high 27 points from Peachtree Ridge’s Duan Day were crucial in the win.

item.title: STRICKLAND: Week six under the Gold Dome
item.description: We’ve officially reached the halfway point of the 2026 Legislative Session, and I want you to know exactly where things stand.

item.title: Senate panel rewrites bill protecting Georgians from data centers’ power costs
item.description: Georgia senators rejected a proposal Tuesday that would have explicitly prevented power companies from passing on data centers’ costs to customers, instead advancing a bill with fewer consumer protections.

item.title: Man dead after ‘apparent self-inflicted gunshot wound’ following hours-long standoff with officers
item.description: An unidentified man is deceased after an hours-long standoff with deputies from the Newton County Sheriff’s Office. The NCSO named an “apparent self-inflicted gunshot wound” as the cause of death.
